## Markdown mirrors (for AI crawlers)

Every page is also available as clean Markdown, generated at build time:

- Full corpus (all pages): [llms-full.txt](https://hkpeptides.net/llms-full.txt)
- Mirror index: [markdown/index.md](https://hkpeptides.net/markdown/index.md)
- Pattern: `https://hkpeptides.net/markdown/{path}.md`
